q: How does a car workshop split generator and grid electricity in its footprint?
title: Car workshops: generator vs grid
short: Count them separately. Grid kWh go to Scope 2 at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. Diesel for the generator goes to Scope 1 at 2.68 kg CO2 per litre. Do not also convert the generator's kWh, or you count the same power twice.
audience: Car dealer workshops and independent garages with backup generators

p: Grid kWh from the bill, x 0.710.
Generator litres from fuel invoices, x 2.68.
Report the two lines in their own scopes.
The generator's emissions come from the diesel burned. Its kWh output is useful for cost, not for carbon.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
